description: Twelve 2/0 E-AC-3 frames at 48 kHz whose two channels use the adaptive hybrid transform with every gain adaptive quantization mode in turn, vector quantization, gains of 1, 2 and 4, tags and large values, and mantissas in every bin (A/52 Annex E 3.4).

skip.skip_insertion: The check rewrites E-AC-3 frames with skip fields.
